newsitem.title: USA: First Industrial sees $96.1 mln from offering.
newsitem.headline: First Industrial sees $96.1 mln from offering.

text.p: First Industrial Realty Trust Inc said Monday it plans to use an anticipated $96.1 million raised from selling depositary shares to repay some outstanding debt under the company's acquisition facility.
First Industrial, a real estate investment trust that owns, manages, acquires and develops bulk warehouse and light industrial properties, is offering 4.0 million depositary shares.

The shares each represent 1/100 of a share of the company's Series B cumulative preferred stock with a liquidation preference equivalent to $25 per depositary share, to yield 8.75 percent, the company said.
The company also said it has granted to the underwriters for the offering an option to purchase up to an additional 600,000 shares to cover over-allotments.

The depositary shares will be redeemable at the option of the company at any time after five years at $25 per share, plus accrued and unpaid dividends. The annual dividend on the Depositary Shares is $2.1875 per share, the company said.
Underwriters are Smith Barney Inc and Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp. First Industrial shares were unchanged at 29-3/4 Monday.
